message: UPDATE on propertyfields — verify the WHERE clause is bounded; unbounded mass mutations cause replication lag and pool exhaustion.
help: Static analysis cannot prove a WHERE clause bounds the row count. If the UPDATE can match more than ~10K rows, batch the operation: identify the target rows by primary key in chunks (ORDER BY pk LIMIT N), then loop. Mass UPDATEs on big tables block replication for minutes, can exhaust the connection pool by piling app writes behind row locks, and produce huge WAL volume which lags replicas. If you have verified the WHERE clause bounds the rows tightly (e.g. WHERE id = constant), suppress with `-- safemigrate:ignore=update-delete-row-scope reason="bounded by PK"`.

lock_impact.blocks: writes to the rows it touches (reads still OK)
lock_impact.note: the real risk is replication lag and WAL volume, not table-level blocking — batch large mutations
